run_search: run a full batched MCTS search with root priors, recurrent function, and action selection policies
simulate_tree_traversal: simulate tree traversal from root to leaf using action selection and max depth constraints
expand_tree_nodes: expand unvisited tree nodes by evaluating recurrent function and updating tree topology
backward_propagate_values: backward propagate values up the tree from leaf nodes to root updating visit counts and values
instantiate_tree_from_root: instantiate an empty MCTS tree from root prior logits, value, and embedding for batched search
